About this item

  • Premium Polycarbonate Frame: Crafted from high-quality polycarbonate, WMP's retro-inspired round sunglasses for women offer a lightweight, durable design with a modern, stylish look—ideal for daily wear, outdoor activities, and adding a touch of sophistication to any outfit.
  • Polarized Lenses to Reduce Glare: Featuring polarized lenses, these sunglasses reduce glare and reflections, ensuring clear, sharp vision and optimal comfort whether you're driving, enjoying the outdoors, or relaxing in bright sunlight.
  • 100% UVA/UVB Protection + Accessories: Shield your eyes from UV rays with 100% UVA/UVB protection. The included microfiber pouch not only protects your sunglasses but also doubles as a cleaning cloth, keeping them in pristine condition wherever you go.
  • Shatter-Resistant Lenses for Durability: Designed with shatter-resistant lenses, Drew sunglasses offer added durability, ensuring long-lasting performance and reliability, even in active environments.
  • Affordable Designer-Quality Eyewear: Blending modern design with retro aesthetics, WMP’s round sunglasses for women deliver high-end, designer-quality frames at an accessible price—combining style, durability, and value for the fashion-forward woman.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these sunglasses to be of good quality, with a look and feel that makes them appear more expensive than they are. They appreciate the polarization, with one customer noting they work well for water and sun activities, and the perfect dark tint that isn't too dark. Customers find them lightweight and worth the price, with many receiving compliments on their appearance. The fit receives mixed feedback - while the nose piece doesn't get caught in hair, some customers report they fall off when bending their head down.

  • A. Calhoun
    5 out of 5 stars
    Just buy them. There is nothing not to love!
    Reviewed in the United States on June 9, 2026
    Color: Beige Tortoise Frame / Brown Gradient Lens
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I've had these for a year now and came back and ordered three more pairs. I wear these daily because they are so comfortable and cute. A lot of sunglasses give me headaches- either they are too tight or too heavy, these never do. They don't catch in your hair if you put them on your head. They don't slide down your nose when you sweat or move your head. The black pair isn't matte black which I dislike it's more satin black. The beige tortoiseshell is the prettiest most flattering color ever. I'm a dark winter and I struggle to find cute sunglass colors that aren't black. So many sunglasses lean brown and warm toned; the beige tortoiseshell is a unique cool-toned color with a violet undertone and flattering for my cool and neutral toned gals. I have a pretty normal size head and these are just a hint of oversized but in a good way. I have an oval face that leans long oval or slight heart and these are seriously flattering. I have so many photos in them and they always look good from any angle. I love the thin metal arms. Just buy these- it's such a good buy and brand. I literally donated other pairs because I don't wear them anymore after discovering these. I bought obviously the beige tortoiseshell, black with gold, and the cherry. Cherry is also a cool toned cherry and the gradient brown lenses don't read too warm they really read more grey. I barely got the cherry and it's very beautiful and a unique sunglass color as well. Debating on the green pair too but worried it might be too yellow undertones. My only wish is more color options. I'd love more silver arm options. Thanks WMP for these!

About this Item

  • Premium Polycarbonate Frame: Crafted from high-quality polycarbonate, WMP's retro-inspired round sunglasses for women offer a lightweight, durable design with a modern, stylish look—ideal for daily wear, outdoor activities, and adding a touch of sophistication to any outfit.
  • Polarized Lenses to Reduce Glare: Featuring polarized lenses, these sunglasses reduce glare and reflections, ensuring clear, sharp vision and optimal comfort whether you're driving, enjoying the outdoors, or relaxing in bright sunlight.
  • 100% UVA/UVB Protection + Accessories: Shield your eyes from UV rays with 100% UVA/UVB protection. The included microfiber pouch not only protects your sunglasses but also doubles as a cleaning cloth, keeping them in pristine condition wherever you go.
  • Shatter-Resistant Lenses for Durability: Designed with shatter-resistant lenses, Drew sunglasses offer added durability, ensuring long-lasting performance and reliability, even in active environments.
  • Affordable Designer-Quality Eyewear: Blending modern design with retro aesthetics, WMP’s round sunglasses for women deliver high-end, designer-quality frames at an accessible price—combining style, durability, and value for the fashion-forward woman.

Product Description

Drew borrows from classic elements of vintage style, with circular lenses, a distinctive key hole nose bridge and sleek stainless steel arms. With the same vibe as timeless retro designs, these shades promise to always stay on trend.
